nodes.label: giants scan command
nodes.rationale: Searches GitHub, package registries, HN, arXiv/HF and web; clones top 3 GitHub candidates for code reading; 2-5 min, ~$0.3-0.8.

nodes.label: giants recent command
nodes.rationale: Reuse recent reports (24h) to avoid paying twice.

nodes.label: giants collect command
nodes.rationale: Costs money per message; must run --dry first and only proceed with user consent.

nodes.label: giants deep command (task deep-dive)
nodes.rationale: Reads task session prompts + project source to find blockers; searches by problem rather than same-kind products; incremental re-runs; quotes cost first with spending cap (default $2).

nodes.label: giants auth command
nodes.rationale: Users paste API key themselves; agent must never enter keys.

nodes.label: Local page server on 127.0.0.1:4848
nodes.rationale: Listens only on loopback so settings/API keys are not exposed to network.

nodes.label: Quota modes auto / subscription / api
nodes.rationale: auto uses Claude subscription first then falls back to API key when quota is exhausted.

nodes.rationale: Has read-only tools only and never runs repo code, since cloned content is untrusted.

nodes.label: Canary/control GitHub search (repo:torvalds/linux)
nodes.rationale: If the control search fails the channel is broken (rate limit/auth), so empty results cannot be reported as 'nothing exists'.
